proofLimits: Anonymous HTTP only; no hosted browser, file import, IndexedDB, query, model, account or production-write proof.
Owner supplied deployment/source identity is context, not independently re-attested by these HTTP requests.
Header files are Python parsed-header serializations, not wire-byte captures; sensitive values are confined to 0600 private files and redacted from labelled sanitized files.
Bodies are bounded original HTTP representations requested with Accept-Encoding identity; incomplete prefixes are explicitly marked, not full-file hashes.
No cookies/auth sent, no inherited proxy, no redirects followed, no protection bypass or authentication retry.
